overview: This file traces Japan’s wartime finances from 1941 to 1944 through reports on frozen assets, bank withdrawals, gold shipments and commodity purchases in South America. It also documents Japanese budgets, debt, savings, inflation and bondholders’ claims. A substantial 1944 draft manual sets out financial and accounting procedures for U.S. civil affairs forces in Japan.
interest: Pairs detailed wartime financial intelligence with bondholder correspondence and a draft manual for administering occupied Japan.
